offsets: Unicode code points; zero-based half-open; PyMuPDF 1.28.2 text sort=False
scope: Frozen first5 responses and their selected evidence; no model call or candidate replacement
exact_match_precedence: Use exact unique match first; overlapping duplicate occurrences are ambiguous
allowed_diagnostic_operations: Remove one complete enclosing json fence, without JSON repair
Fold whitespace runs while preserving a word boundary and character map
Remove U+00AD only at an ASCII-letter boundary, logged with source offsets
Join a line break after a retained ASCII lexical hyphen before an ASCII letter
Hypothesize removal of ASCII hyphen plus line break between ASCII letters; ALWAYS flag for review
disallowed_operations: Global punctuation, number, minus sign, negation, or citation-marker removal
Case folding or generic NFKC substitution
Deletion of an inline lexical hyphen
Joining digits across a line-end hyphen
Accepting multiple occurrences or arbitrary source substitutions
preexisting_patch_handling: Only the frozen equal-length trimmomatic_p03_prime_glyphs_v1 patch is recognized; raw PDF glyphs and differences are preserved
line_end_hyphen_removal_acceptance: Unique mapping hypothesis only; not automatic acceptance
uniqueness_scope: Within the selected candidate; never silently choose among repeated occurrences
PDF_mapping_requirement: Replay full candidate and matched intervals against hash-verified PDF; block boxes remain block-level
